title: LiquidGEMM: Hardware-Efficient W4A8 GEMM Kernel for High-Performance LLM Serving
problem: Quantization accelerates LLM inference by reducing memory and computation. W4A8 (4-bit weights, 8-bit activations) balances accuracy-performance tradeoff, but existing GEMM kernels suffer inefficient dequantization on CUDA Cores, unable to match Tensor Core throughput.
motivation: LLM inference dominates modern AI workloads requiring low latency and high throughput. Quantization essential for efficient serving, but kernel-level optimization of W4A8 remains challenging. Dequantization bottleneck undermines Tensor Core performance gains.
method: LiquidGEMM accelerates 4-bit weight, 8-bit activation matrix operations using two techniques. LiquidQuant converts compressed 4-bit weights back into usable form using just 2 operations per 4 elements while preventing overflow. The kernel then overlaps three tasks—loading weights, converting them, and performing matrix multiplication—across parallel thread groups without pausing any threads or repeating data from memory.
key_novelty: LiquidQuant converts 4-bit weights in just 2 operations per 4 elements, fast enough that W4A8 matrix operations run all computation stages in parallel on Tensor Cores without needing thread synchronization.
contributions: LiquidQuant quantization format enabling fast, overflow-safe 2-instruction dequantization
Implicit fine-grained pipeline overlapping computation and data movement across warp groups
limitations: Abstract-only; specific LLM models tested, memory requirements, and applicability to other quantization schemes not detailed.
primary_theme: Specialized quantization kernels for LLM inference
